info.title: HumanTaskBridge API
info.description: Human-operated asynchronous task requests, free private suggestions and optional support. Preview is the default. Business mutations require X-HTB-Client and idempotency headers. The same-origin aggregate page-view collector and dedicated authenticated mail relay use X-HTB-Client without an idempotency key. No endpoint initiates fund transfers; receiving is verified manually. No administrative email, wallet extended key or internal notes are exposed by unauthenticated public endpoints.

get.description: Contributions do not buy tasks or priority. Agent donations require explicit donation authorization and budget. No transfer is initiated. preview and taskPreview both describe task preview mode. liveContributionsEnabled reflects the explicit SUPPORT_ENABLED flag, not the existence of a receiving method. post.summary: Retry a failed notification within safe deduplication window
post.description: Sent, simulated and actively sending events cannot be retried. Gmail relay deliveries that have started require manual reconciliation and cannot be automatically resent. Resend delivery more than 23 hours after delivery_started_at requires provider reconciliation. Weekly reports older than 35 days cannot be retried. Quota-deferred events that have never reached the provider have no started-delivery window.

post.summary: Record a public in-page navigation without cookies
post.description: Used by the website only after an actual public SPA pathname change. Initial HTTP requests are collected separately and must not be repeated here. Sends no query, fragment, referrer, credential, or browser identifier. Same origin and X-HTB-Client: 1 are required; omit cookies. No Idempotency-Key is required. Do Not Track and Global Privacy Control signals suppress collection. Administrative, private, authentication and unknown paths are excluded. The generic response reveals no visitor or collection data. Unknown paths are ignored with the same 204 response; invalid body types or extra fields return 400.

path.description: Exact public pathname; only /, /services, /request, /suggest, /support, /docs, /terms, /privacy, /refunds and /acceptable-use are eligible. Unknown paths are ignored. Never include query or fragment.

204.description: No content; no collection details returned.

400.description: Invalid JSON body, field types, or unexpected fields.

post.summary: Lease at most one private notification for the authorized SMTP relay
post.description: Machine-only endpoint requiring the dedicated MAIL_RELAY_TOKEN bearer credential and EMAIL_MODE=gmail_relay. This is not a task credential or Cloudflare Access session. Send an empty JSON object and X-HTB-Client: 1; query parameters and target overrides are rejected. Origin and fetch-site checks still apply when those headers are present. No Idempotency-Key is required. A successful claim reserves the shared email budget and a five-minute lease; the caller receives the fixed sole-owner sender and recipient, frozen text, ephemeral leaseToken and deterministic Message-ID. notification:null means no deliverable item, including a quota wait. Do not replay an ambiguous claim to recover its payload. Expired SMTP leases or already attempted deliveries require manual review rather than automatic resend. Responses contain private data and must not be logged or exposed to visitors.

200.description: A private notification with a five-minute lease, or no available notification.

post.summary: Record one SMTP delivery outcome without sending another email
post.description: Uses the same dedicated relay bearer, JSON body and X-HTB-Client header as claim. No query parameters or Idempotency-Key. Supply the notification id and ephemeral leaseToken returned by claim. Completion must reach the Worker within the five-minute lease. Repeating the same completed outcome with the same lease is idempotent and never sends mail; conflicting outcomes, expired leases and unknown ownership return 409. For sent, optional providerId must equal the claim's deterministic messageId; it is not evidence of inbox delivery or reading. For failed, optional errorCode defaults to smtp_delivery_uncertain. Do not send raw SMTP errors, credentials, recipients or message content in this request. SMTP uncertainty requires manual reconciliation, not automatic resend.

200.description: Outcome recorded, or identical completion already recorded.

409.description: Lease unavailable or expired, conflicting outcome, or manual review required.

get.summary: Read a private weekly aggregate traffic report and email readiness
get.description: Requires verified administrative authentication. Select the current UTC week (default, still in progress) or previous completed UTC week. Collection coverage can be partial. The delivery object describes configuration and the selected report state; configuration alone is not proof of email delivery. A mock mode sends no real email.

200.description: Weekly aggregate report and delivery readiness.

mode.description: Configured transport mode. gmail_relay is drained by the dedicated external SMTP workflow; configuration alone is not proof of delivery.

sentAt.description: Provider acceptance timestamp when recorded; not proof of inbox delivery or reading.

errorCode.description: Redacted operational delivery issue code, when present.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired credential

TaskBearer.description: Only the hash is stored. Credential expires after 90 days or earlier revocation. Never use query parameters.

CloudflareAccess.name: Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion
CloudflareAccess.description: Signed JWT provided by Cloudflare Access; backend verifies issuer, audience, RS256 signature and sole configured administrator. A plain email header is not authentication.

MailRelayBearer.bearerFormat: Dedicated canonical base64url secret of at least 32 random bytes
MailRelayBearer.description: Private machine credential matching MAIL_RELAY_TOKEN. Accepted only by the two mail-relay endpoints, independently of task credentials and Cloudflare Access. Never include it in query parameters, logs, browser assets or public examples.

MailRelayInvalid.description: Invalid JSON object, unknown fields, query parameters or completion values.

MailRelayUnauthorized.description: Missing or invalid dedicated relay bearer credential.

MailRelayUnavailable.description: gmail_relay mode, dedicated token, sole-owner sender/recipient or canonical HTTPS origin is not configured.

Client.name: X-HTB-Client
Client.description: Explicit JSON client header; origin checks still apply.

Idempotency.name: Idempotency-Key
Idempotency.description: Keep key and JSON body identical for retries. Stored for seven days.

NewToken.name: X-Request-Token
NewToken.description: Recommended: 32 cryptographically random bytes encoded base64url, saved before creation and reused on retries.

MailRelayLeaseToken.description: Canonical unpadded base64url credential containing at least 32 bytes. Claim currently generates 32 random bytes. Only its hash is retained as lease ownership.

from.description: Private configured owner identity; identical to the sole authorized recipient.

subject.description: Fixed notification subject without control characters.

text.description: Private frozen plain-text notification or validated weekly aggregates, without customer-supplied task text.

messageId.description: Deterministic RFC Message-ID to preserve when sending and acknowledging; SMTP does not guarantee deduplication from this value.

providerId.description: Optional; if supplied, must exactly equal the claim's messageId. The same deterministic value is stored when omitted.

category.description: Use a service ID currently returned by GET /api/capabilities. The operator can edit categories.

token.description: Returned once on first creation; never stored as plaintext. Omitted on replay.

privateUrl.description: Supported tracking page with the opaque record ID and kind in its fragment. Contains no access credential; enter the separately saved token on that page.

qrDataUrl.description: Locally generated QR containing the address; network, asset and amount remain explicit adjacent text.

payment.description: Payment instructions and QR are shown to the client only for an accepted current proposal in pending/claimed state while valid and allowed by current configuration.

services.description: Unique IDs; changing this list changes accepted categories for new requests.

csrfToken.description: Use X-HTB-Client: 1. This is not an authentication credential.

acknowledgeCanceledPayment.description: Explicit operator acknowledgement when recording received funds for a cancelled task. Keeps the task cancelled and does not authorize execution; enables manual refund review.

partial.description: True for a current week, late collection start, or unknown collection start. Earlier traffic is not reconstructed.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, or unknown.

WeeklyTrafficReport.description: Aggregate observations, not verified human counts. Known bots are separated from unclassified traffic, which may include undetected automation. Website and agent-resource visitor estimates overlap and must not be summed. Raw IPs, user-agent strings, full referrers, queries and credentials are not returned.
